verdict.rationale: Docs confirm access to current-gen H100 (behind an approval gate) and older/cheaper Ampere A100 GPUs, plus the ability to switch instance types for a cost/performance mix, which covers the core of the story. However, there is no evidence of H200 or B200-class GPUs, and the approval requirement for H100 suggests availability isn't seamless. Missing for 10: explicit H200/B200 listing, clarity on approval turnaround/availability, and independent confirmation of GPU tier pricing differences.
